Proyecto independiente para interactuar con Snort® 3. No está afiliado, patrocinado ni respaldado por Cisco o Cisco Talos. Snort es una marca de Cisco y/o sus afiliadas. SEPARACIÓN DE COMPONENTES
La GPL de la interfaz no relicencia el motor, las reglas ni las bibliotecas. Snort se ejecuta como programa externo por línea de comandos; sus alertas se leen desde archivos. No se enlaza su código dentro de esta GUI. Esta descripción no sustituye una revisión de compatibilidad al cambiar la arquitectura.

FUENTES Y DISTRIBUCIÓN
El botón GitHub abre el perfil del desarrollador; todavía no existe un enlace publicado y verificado al código de esta versión. El proyecto local incluye fuentes, recetas y parches. Antes de distribuir una release debe ofrecerse el código fuente correspondiente y los avisos exigidos. Si se distribuye el motor modificado, deben conservarse su licencia, avisos, fuentes correspondientes, parches e instrucciones de construcción. Qt/PySide6 se usan como bibliotecas del sistema, reemplazables; los instaladores de esta GUI no las incorporan.

ALCANCE DEL INVENTARIO
Se muestran componentes directos y versiones de las bibliotecas cargadas. No es un SBOM exhaustivo ni una auditoría de todas las dependencias transitivas. Los avisos locales de bibliotecas proceden del host Kali de desarrollo; otras distribuciones pueden incorporar versiones, parches y avisos adicionales. Sus paquetes conservan sus propios avisos. Los textos legales originales se conservan en su idioma.

REGLAS Y SEGURIDAD

Esta aplicación no distribuye esos conjuntos ni concede suscripciones; las reglas del laboratorio son ejemplos propios. No compartir credenciales ni Oinkcodes. El software no garantiza detectar o impedir todas las intrusiones; el perfil de laboratorio sobre loopback no protege toda la red.

LEGAL INFORMATION AND COMPONENTS

Interface developed by Jan Herrera. Copyright © 2026 Jan Herrera.
The interface is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later: you may modify and redistribute it under that license. No warranty is provided, to the extent permitted by law. Read the full license; this summary neither replaces the licenses nor guarantees freedom from claims.

INDEPENDENCE AND TRADEMARKS
Independent project for interacting with Snort® 3. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Cisco or Cisco Talos. Snort is a trademark of Cisco and/or its affiliates. Other trademarks belong to their respective owners. Attribution does not grant trademark permission. JALTRIX is the selected application name; trademark availability has not been certified. The full logo and vector shield were supplied by Jan Herrera for this version. The original SVG artwork is preserved; this design change does not certify exclusive rights or trademark availability. It is not the official Snort logo.

SEPARATE COMPONENTS
The interface license does not relicense the engine, rules, or libraries. Snort runs as an external command-line program; alerts are read from files. Its code is not linked into this GUI. This description does not replace a compatibility review when the architecture changes.

SOURCE AND DISTRIBUTION
The GitHub button opens the developer profile; there is not yet a published, verified source link for this release. The local project includes source, build recipes, and patches. Before distributing a release, provide corresponding source and required notices. Distributing a modified engine requires retaining its license, notices, corresponding source, patches, and build instructions. Qt/PySide6 are replaceable system libraries; the GUI installers do not bundle them.

INVENTORY SCOPE
Direct components and loaded library versions are shown. This is not an exhaustive SBOM or a complete transitive dependency audit. Local library notices come from the Kali development host; other distributions may include different versions, patches, and additional notices. Their packages retain their own notices. Original legal texts remain in their original language.

RULES AND SECURITY
Community Rules: GPLv2; check each ruleset's notices. Registered/Subscriber: separate Cisco agreement, not GPL simply because they can be downloaded. This application does not distribute those sets or grant subscriptions; lab rules are original examples. Do not share credentials or Oinkcodes. The software does not guarantee detection or prevention of every intrusion; the loopback lab profile does not protect the entire network.
